CrewMember.description: A person on the production crew. A first name alone is not an identity.

Scene.description: A scene in the script, known by its working title.

Reporting.description: Who a crew member answers to: their department head, or the person they assist.

SceneRole.description: Who holds a creative role on a scene: its director, its camera operator or its gaffer.

Setup.description: One camera setup on the schedule. called_by asked for it, rigged_by builds the rig, approved_by signs it off. A wish for a shot is not a scheduled setup.

Expense.description: Money a crew member spent for the production. reimbursed stays empty until a repayment is recorded.

questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Scene)-[:director]->(n1:CrewMember) WHERE n0.name = 'Rooftop Chase' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Who is the gaffer on Diner Confession?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Scene)-[:gaffer]->(n1:CrewMember) WHERE n0.name = 'Diner Confession' RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Scene)-[:operator]->(n1:CrewMember) WHERE n0.name = 'Night Market' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: itzel
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:CrewMember)-[:directed]->(n1:Scene) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: ayumi
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:CrewMember)-[:team]->(n1:CrewMember) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: henrik_m
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:CrewMember)-[:head]->(n1:CrewMember) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Has the crane rental been reimbursed?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Expense) WHERE n0.item = 'crane rental' RETURN n0.reimbursed AS reimbursed

questions.q: Is there a record of the gaffer tape being reimbursed?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Expense) WHERE n0.item = 'gaffer tape' RETURN coalesce(n0.reimbursed, false) AS reimbursed

questions.q: Who called setups on Diner Confession?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Scene)<-[:scene]-(n1:Setup)-[:called_by]->(n2:CrewMember) WHERE n0.name = 'Diner Confession' RETURN n2.name AS name

questions.q: Which setups did Henrik Dahl call?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:CrewMember)<-[:called_by]-(n1:Setup) WHERE n0.name = 'Henrik Dahl' RETURN n1.setup AS setup

questions.q: How many takes did the jetty wide need?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Setup) WHERE n0.setup = 'jetty wide' RETURN n0.takes AS takes

questions.q: What setups and statuses are there for Rooftop Chase?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Scene)<-[:scene]-(n1:Setup) WHERE n0.name = 'Rooftop Chase' RETURN n1.setup AS setup, n1.status AS status

questions.q: What takes did the shot setups need?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Setup) WHERE n0.setup CONTAINS 'shot' RETURN n0.takes AS takes

questions.q: Did the drone pass need a crane?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Setup) WHERE n0.setup = 'drone pass' RETURN n0.needs_crane AS needs_crane

questions.q: Is there a record that the market wide needs a crane?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Setup) WHERE n0.setup = 'market wide' RETURN coalesce(n0.needs_crane, false) AS needs_crane

questions.q: How much did Ravi Subramaniam spend?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:CrewMember)<-[:spender]-(n1:Expense) WHERE n0.name = 'Ravi Subramaniam' RETURN n1.amount_euros AS amount_euros
